title: Dispatch: fa54 (Haiku 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-fa54 (bd show eshyra-fa54). Supervisor decisions below are made.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-fa54.1 on branch eshyra-fa54.1 (cut from origin/main). Deps installed.
FILE BOUNDARY: a parallel task edits packages/core/src/character/ (levelUpEngine.ts, finalizeCharacter.ts, spellPreparation.ts) and their tests. Do not edit packages/core/src/character/ at all.

CODE SURVEY (verified by supervisor)
- packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts EVENT_RESETS (~line 235): short_rest resets recharge_roll, short_rest, short_or_long_rest; long_rest additionally long_rest; dawn resets dawn.
- packages/core/src/state/rest.ts (~line 700-725): completeLongRest/completeShortRest call resetUsage(event, owner character) for each participant.
- packages/core/src/state/classResources.ts: Rage -> long_rest, Ki -> short_or_long_rest, Sorcery Points -> long_rest; counters are pack-bound and created on first spend_usage (tests for this live in packages/core/test/levelUpEngine.test.ts — use them as fixture examples).

DECISIONS
1. This bead is confirmation evidence, not new behaviour: add end-to-end tests (in packages/core/test/rest.test.ts or usageCounters.test.ts, whichever already has rest fixtures) proving through the real rest operations (completeShortRest / completeLongRest, not resetUsage directly):
   - monk with Ki partially spent: short rest restores Ki fully;
   - sorcerer with Sorcery Points spent: short rest does NOT restore them; long rest does;
   - barbarian Rage spent: short rest does not, long rest does;
   - a multi-point spend (spend_usage uses: 3 on Sorcery Points) decrements by 3 and is refused when it exceeds remaining.
   If any of these fails, STOP: do not change behaviour, record the failing case in notes and file a bug bead.
2. Flexible Casting / Metamagic disposition: Metamagic and other sorcery-point costs are already expressible as spend_usage with uses = cost (DM-adjudicated cost choice). Flexible Casting (sorcery points <-> spell slots via the Creating Spell Slots table) is a genuine deterministic capability touching slot state; do NOT implement it here. File one follow-up bead (bd create, P3, label srd, discovered-from eshyra-fa54) titled 'Flexible Casting: deterministic sorcery-point <-> spell-slot conversion' describing the table, the slot owner (state/spellSlots.ts) and the counter owner (usageCounters.ts).
3. No source changes expected. If a test reveals a genuine defect, stop as in 1.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-fa54.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-fa54.1 --append-notes` (tests, results, follow-up id); `bd close eshyra-fa54.1`.
